# Webamp 2.3.1

`webamp.bundle.min.mjs` is the ES-module build from the `webamp` npm package,
version 2.3.1, copied unmodified. Webamp is MIT licensed (per its package.json);
source, license and authors: https://github.com/captbaritone/webamp

Loaded on demand by `public/app/webamp.js` when a page's audio is played.
